intro: Goretusk Liver Pie is a culinary errand undertaken for Salma Saldean at the Saldean Farm in Westfall. With the breadbasket of the kingdom ravaged by drought and bandits, local homesteaders rely on hunting the aggressive local boars to put a hearty meal on the table. Assisting Salma provides a rare taste of comfort and home-cooked hospitality in an otherwise bleak frontier.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The onions are peeled. The garlic is minced. The rosemary is crushed. The crust has been baked. The dill weed is chopped. The gravy is simmering. Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!

clips.title: Progress
paras: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!

clips.title: Completion
paras: These are just perfect, friend! Thank you so much. Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight. And here is a little something for you, for the hard work. You didn't think I was going to let an adventurer like you go hungry, did you?
